  | lit : Nat → Expr
  | add : Expr → Expr → Expr
inductive Instr where
  | push : Nat → Instr
  | plus : Instr
def eval : Expr → Nat
  | .lit n => n
  | .add l r => eval l + eval r
def compile : Expr → List Instr
  | .lit n => [.push n]
  | .add l r => compile l ++ compile r ++ [.plus]
def run : List Instr → List Nat → Option (List Nat)
  | [], s => some s
  | .push n :: code, s => run code (n :: s)
  | .plus :: code, a :: b :: s => run code ((b + a) :: s)
  | .plus :: _, _ => none

theorem compiler_correct (e : Expr) : run (compile e) [] = some [eval e] := by
  have h (e : Expr) : ? (code : List Instr) (s : List Nat),
      run (compile e ++ code) s = run code (eval e :: s) := by

        intro code s
        rfl

        intro code s
        simp [compile, List.append_assoc, hl, hr, run, eval]
  exact h e [] []
